_about: Hand-checked against davidlougheed/strkit at da09c8180fb19a3268fd3af8ad0487989b71f6b3 (tag v0.24.3) on 2026-09-29, from README.md, docs/caller_usage.md, docs/caller_catalog.md, Dockerfile, setup.py, .github/workflows/publish-docker.yml, strkit/entry.py and catalogs/pathogenic_assoc.hg38.tsv at that commit, api.anaconda.org, PyPI, the ghcr.io tag list, the v0.24.3 release, and STRhub's ont_slices/codis_pm10kb.bed.

command.value: strkit call path/to/read/file.bam --hq --realign --ref path/to/reference.fa.gz --loci path/to/loci.bed --incorporate-snvs path/to/dbsnp/00-common_all.vcf.gz --vcf my-calls.vcf --seed 183 --processes 10 --no-tsv
command.where: README.md:162-172 (backslash continuations joined; the '# ...' comment after each backslash removed)

install.documented: python -m pip install strkit (PyPI, Python 3.10+; Rust >= 1.85, a C compiler and cmake may be needed to build strkit_rust_ext), or docker pull ghcr.io/davidlougheed/strkit:latest

published.where: README.md:3,55,78-85; https://api.anaconda.org/package/bioconda/strkit (not found); https://pypi.org/pypi/strkit/json (0.24.3 present); ghcr.io/davidlougheed/strkit tags include 0.24.3, 0.24 and latest; https://github.com/davidlougheed/strkit/releases/tag/v0.24.3 (no assets)

extra_inputs.what: TR locus catalog for --loci: tab-separated, sorted, 0-based half-open BED whose last column is the motif (or ID=...;MOTIF=...), e.g. TRF-, Straglr- or GangSTR-style. The repository ships only catalogs/pathogenic_assoc.hg38.tsv (44 disease loci, none inside the CODIS ±10 kb slice)
extra_inputs.revised: 2026-09-29: STRhub now supplies a chrom/start/end/motif regions file for ont-bam-hg38 (datasets/ont-bam-hg38/regions/motif.bed, the 20 CODIS loci inside the ONT slices).

extra_inputs.what: Indexed reference. The README requires it bgzip-compressed and samtools-faidx-indexed (.fa.gz plus .fai/.gzi); the CLI help only asks for an indexed FASTA. Derivable from STRhub's hg38.fa
SNV catalog VCF for --incorporate-snvs (e.g. dbSNP 00-common_all.vcf.gz, bgzipped and tabix-indexed). Optional, and the README advises against it for targeted data

runnable_on_strhub_data.why: 2026-09-29: STRhub now supplies a chrom/start/end/motif regions file for ont-bam-hg38 (datasets/ont-bam-hg38/regions/motif.bed, the 20 CODIS loci inside the ONT slices). strkit reads a 4-column BED with the motif last (README.md:167, 339-345), so the library's motif file serves as --loci; the documented --incorporate-snvs dbSNP file is a placeholder STRhub does not hold and is dropped.

was.why: strkit call requires a motif-bearing locus catalog (--loci). For ont-bam-hg38 STRhub supplies only hg38.fa: that dataset has no regions library. The one catalog the repository ships (pathogenic_assoc.hg38.tsv) has no locus in the CODIS ±10 kb slice. Everything else would do: the reads are ONT R10 on hg38, and the bgzipped, faidx-indexed reference can be derived from hg38.fa.

notes: strkit is tuned for PacBio HiFi; ONT R10 is accepted with --hq and --realign (README.md:160,183-186). The README example is not valid shell as written: every backslash is followed by '  # comment', so bash would end the command after its first line. The recorded value joins the lines without the comments. A comment-free variant is at docs/caller_usage.md:122-129 (strkit call --loci ... --ref ... --processes 10 --seed 342 --vcf sample.vcf --no-tsv path/to/sample.bam). The other subcommands (visualize, mi, convert) do not genotype. strkit is not on Bioconda or conda-forge; the documented installs are PyPI and the ghcr image, both at 0.24.3. The repository Dockerfile is the recipe the release workflow pushes to ghcr, hence 'dockerfile'. Ambiguity: runnable is false only for want of a catalog. If STRhub gave ont-bam-hg38 its GangSTR-layout BED (motif last), that file would be a valid STRkit catalog once starts are made 0-based (docs/caller_catalog.md:81-85). The docs also point to the UCSC hg38 TRF track as a whole-genome catalog (docs/caller_catalog.md:76-80, 'some work may be required'), but that is an external download STRhub does not hold. Loci on sex chromosomes are skipped unless --sex-chr is given (docs/caller_usage.md:76-77).
